patchScope: Apply auditable metal-shell bearing-edge fallback metadata to metal-shell records with valid numeric shell thickness but unknown/unverified bearing edge.

policyBasis.rule: For metal-shell snare drums only, unknown/unpublished bearing edge details do not block meaningful core-shell usability when shell material, metal shell construction/material, valid shell thickness, diameter, depth, source URL, and source confidence are present.
policyBasis.limitation: This does not source-confirm the bearing edge. It only applies an auditable fallback tier for engine usability.
policyBasis.excluded: Wood ply, solid wood, stave, steam-bent, single-ply, acrylic, hybrid wood, and composite shells remain excluded.
